note: The task-call agent 'Doddy (calls for you)' (ADR-500, docs/decisions/calls.md) has no webhook or client tools on purpose: it cannot pay, book, send, read memories or transfer. Only these ElevenLabs system tools. voice_agent_spec.py --agent task-call fails if anything else is added; the server's drift check (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSafety.ts) refuses calls if the live agent has anything else.

system_tools.name: end_call
system_tools.description: End the call after saying goodbye, once you have the answer, they can't give one, or anything outside the brief was asked.

system_tools.name: voicemail_detection
system_tools.description: Use when a voicemail greeting or answering machine answers. Leave no message.
